senses.definition: comparative form of weak: more weak

quotes.text: Yes, there were hundreds of companies in existence, but a form of natural selection was taking place. Weaker companies were swallowed up by larger ones.
quotes.reference: 2024 July 24, Richard Foster, “Rail reform has never been easy”, in RAIL, number 1014, page 28:

senses.definition: (logic) Said of one proposition with respect to another one: that the latter entails the former, but the former does not entail the latter.
